extracted.name: Graham Cracker Crust
extracted.description: Our easy homemade Graham Cracker Crust is just 3-ingredients and takes less than 15 minutes to make. You can also make it gluten-free or vegan.
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs (, about 12 full sheets, crushed)
instruction_lines: Mix graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter in a small bowl.
Press into Pan: Pour crumb mixture into an 8" - 9.5" pie pan and use the back of a measuring spoon to press it firmly in the bottom and up the sides of the pan.
Bake for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely before filling with your favorite pie.
categories: How to make a graham cracker crust
